thread:
ellie (platform): quick thought: introduce a compact-diff capture for short-lived canaries. store only metadata + token-id deltas + redaction-summary. keep max snapshot ~1KB. open to feedback.

bob (eng-ml): sounds good. recommend token-id + counts + top-2 candidates for changed indices, not raw text. preserves repro signal.

nina (privacy): policy guardrails: automated PII redaction at capture time. no plaintext emails/ssns/phones in stored blobs. reversible unmasking only via HSM, legal ticket, RBAC group. TTL for unmasked copies (default 7d).

sam (support): support needs masked preview (first char + **** for usernames, domain-only for emails). allow async unmask requests with ticket id. UI should log reason and operator.

tom (prod): quota concern: per-tenant snapshot_quota_bytes + burst window required. auto-disable sampling when quota exceeded and emit quota_exhausted event.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: feature/compact-diff -> staging canary

ellie (platform): action items: (bob) prototype encoder + perf bench (2w); (nina) draft unmask/HSM flow (this week); (tom) quota + console alert mockups (EoW); (sam) list support cases needing unmask (EoW). sync tomorrow 11:00 PT. :thumbsup:
